overview: The Training Grounds Arena is where Vah Shir hunters undergo formal trials, sparring sessions, and ceremonial combat rites.
history: The arena was built as the first formal training space for Vah Shir hunters.
Clan instructors developed standardized trials and sparring rituals.
Arcane ward pylons were added to stabilize training energy.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the arena was expanded and reinforced.
Beast-integration drills became a core part of hunter training.
hooks: A sparring match destabilizes an arcane ward.
A beast-integration drill goes out of control.
A ceremonial combat rite requires assistance.
A clan trial escalates into a heroic event.
